blurb: It’s always a marvelous night aboard the moondanceCat, but don’t forget to soak up the sun along our daily sails. The moondanceCat is 56’ long and 31’ wide, built by SeaIsland Boatworks in Charleston, South Carolina, a Kurt Hughes design modeled after the original moondance. Setting sail into a new horizon of accommodation, moondanceCat cruises with up to 75 passengers.
